project.name: Radio San Javier
project.description: Website for a local/community radio station with a home page, weekly schedule, news posts, radio program pages, ads, weather data, and an online radio player.
project.repositoryPurpose: Public website and content hub for Radio San Javier.

home.description: Home page content. It currently renders the schedule shortcode.

pages.description: Standalone pages such as the about page.

posts.description: General news/blog posts. Existing posts use Hugo leaf bundles: content/posts/<slug>/index.md plus local images/resources.

programs.description: Radio program sections. Each program is expected to live under content/programas/<program_slug>/. Example: content/programas/es_lo_que_hay/.

programEpisodesOrNotes.description: Posts, notes, interviews, or episodes that belong to a specific radio program.

schedule.purpose: Defines the weekly radio schedule used by the grilla shortcode and the home 'today' strip.

programTypes.radio_sanjavier: Programs produced by Radio San Javier

ads.purpose: Defines advertisers, image paths, links, active status, and display locations.

weather.purpose: Weather values rendered on the home page. This file is updated by a GitHub Actions workflow using Open-Meteo data.

radio.purpose: Central radio metadata and stream URL used by the embedded home player and the popup player page.

features: Home page strip showing programming by selected day
Weather card updated automatically from Open-Meteo
Embedded home page live radio player
Popup online radio player generated by Hugo from shared radio data
Improved Spanish client-side search with filtered index
No-code content editing tutorial with screenshot placeholders under docs/tutorial-agregar-contenido.md
Reusable podcast RSS feeds for radio programs, including iTunes/Spotify/generic podcast client tags
Archive.org embedded audio player shortcode for program episodes

externalServices.weatherReferenceLink: REM Córdoba station page linked from the home weather card
externalServices.netlifyIdentity: Loaded through layouts/partials/extend-head.html for CMS authentication
externalServices.archiveOrg: Program episodes may embed Archive.org items with layouts/shortcodes/archive-player.html and use Archive.org direct MP3 URLs for podcast enclosures

knownIssuesOrCleanupItems.details: Both root hugo.toml and config/_default/hugo.toml exist. They currently point to the same site identity, but confirm which one the deployment uses.
Some posts and pages appear to be drafts or test content and may need cleanup before production.
static/admin/config.yml currently exposes program pages and episode collections for selected programs. Add new episode collections when more programs need editor access.
public/ contains generated output. Avoid editing it manually; confirm whether the project intentionally tracks generated files.

agentGuidelines: Read this file first when starting work on the repository.
Prefer editing content/ or data/ before changing layouts.
Do not edit the Blowfish theme directly unless explicitly requested; use project-level layout overrides instead.
Do not manually edit public/ unless explicitly requested; it is generated output.
To change the weekly schedule, edit data/grilla.json.
To change advertisers, edit data/publicidades.json and place images under static/publicidades/ or another static path.
To change the live stream URL, edit data/radio.json. The embedded home player and popup player page both read from this file.
Keep user-facing text in Spanish appropriate for Argentina unless the user requests otherwise.
When adding content, prefer Hugo leaf bundles for posts and program episodes so images can live next to index.md.
For podcast episodes, keep Params.audio as a list of URL strings because Blowfish/OpenGraph expects strings. Put rich RSS enclosure metadata in Params.enclosures.
For Archive.org episodes, use the archive-player shortcode with the Archive.org identifier and use https://archive.org/metadata/<identifier> to find exact MP3 filenames, sizes, durations, and images.
Decap CMS is configured in static/admin/config.yml with collections for news, program pages, selected program episodes, radio data, and ads.
Episode entries managed by Decap use cmsType=episode so folder collections can exclude program _index.md files.
Before large refactors, explain the intended change and ask for confirmation.
